svg.title: Shared sequence variants inform an inferred evolutionary relationship
svg.desc: Three aligned sequences share most positions. Samples A and B share a variant not found in C. A simple branching diagram groups A and B, while a note states that robust inference requires many sites and an explicit model.
svg.text: Relationships are inferred from shared variation
A C G T A C C G
A C G T A C T G
A C G C A C T G
A and B share T at the highlighted site.
This single site is illustrative, not sufficient evidence for ancestry.
Robust inference uses many informative sites, suitable sampling and an evolutionary model.
